title: Adult CPR • chest landmark
caption: Locator diagram only; a trained reviewer must check the chest landmark and any subsequent hand-position artwork.
alt: Front view of adult torso with the lower half of the sternum highlighted.
scope: Landmark only; full hand and body-position sequence pending.

title: AED • typical adult pad locations
caption: Typical adult front-side placement sketch; device-specific and pediatric positioning are not shown.
alt: Adult torso with one pad below the person’s right collarbone and another on the left side below the armpit.
scope: Typical adult placement only, not pediatric or device-specific placement.

title: Severe choking • adult or child
caption: Sequence for a responsive adult or child with severe choking; special circumstances require chest thrusts.
alt: Flow chart alternating five back blows and five abdominal thrusts, then CPR if unresponsive.
scope: Sequence only; photos of correct body and hand placement still pending.

title: Severe choking • infant
caption: Sequence for a responsive infant with severe choking; the 2025 AHA uses the heel of one hand for chest thrusts. Technique and positioning artwork is still pending.
alt: Flow chart alternating five back blows and five chest thrusts, then CPR if unresponsive.
scope: Sequence only; photos of correct body and hand placement still pending.

title: Severe bleeding • direct pressure
caption: Direct-pressure concept; follow emergency guidance and use other bleeding-control methods as appropriate.
alt: A dressing sits over a limb; a downward arrow indicates direct pressure onto the dressing.
scope: Direct pressure concept only, not hand positioning or wound-packing.

title: Tourniquet • limb location concept
caption: The spacing is schematic, not to scale. Location alone is not an application demonstration. Use training, device instructions, and dispatcher guidance.
alt: A limb diagram shows a band toward the torso, two to three inches above an injury marker, not on a joint.
scope: Placement concept only; not a complete tourniquet application guide.

title: Recovery position • decision reminder
caption: This visual supports recognition only. It is not a demonstration of how to turn a person.
alt: Decision chart distinguishes normal breathing and safe movement from suspected injury and abnormal breathing.
scope: Decision aid only; actual side-position sequence pending.

title: Tick removal • close-up
caption: Grip the tick close to the skin and pull away with steady, even pressure. This is a magnified schematic.
alt: Two close-up drawings depict tweezer tips gripping the tick near its mouthparts and pulling it away from the skin.
scope: Tick removal schematic; anatomical and technique review pending.

title: Adult CPR • compression quality
caption: Use dispatcher guidance and an AED as soon as available.
alt: Three pictograms show chest target, clock and hand for recoil.
scope: Target, rate and recoil only; hands and shoulder alignment still need a validated demonstration.

title: Child CPR • key differences
caption: Rescue breaths are important in children; follow dispatcher instructions.
alt: Chest, hand and clock pictograms summarize child CPR compression concepts.
scope: Concept only, no compression technique or hand alignment shown.

title: Infant CPR • updated techniques
caption: Use an approved physical demonstration to learn the techniques.
alt: Two generic hand icons identify accepted methods and a prohibition icon labels the retired two-finger method.
scope: Technique names only; icons are not placement illustrations. Both actual hand-position images remain pending.

title: AED • pediatric pad safety
caption: Do not delay defibrillation while searching for pediatric pads.
alt: AED, separate pads and prohibition sign represent pediatric AED safety.
scope: Device and pad recognition; no placement diagram for a specific patient or device.

title: Infant choking • safety reminders
caption: Get emergency help; start CPR if the infant becomes unresponsive.
alt: Head support, generic hand and prohibition icons accompany infant choking safety reminders.
scope: Safety reminders only; not an anatomical demonstration. Heel-of-hand chest thrust and supported positioning still need validated art.

title: Severe choking • response reminders
caption: Begin CPR if the person becomes unresponsive.
alt: Phone, hand and prohibition icons accompany choking response reminders.
scope: Sequence reminders; physical back-blow and thrust positioning still pending.

title: Recovery position • monitoring
caption: If breathing becomes abnormal or stops, follow dispatcher CPR guidance.
alt: Phone, shield and clock depict call, movement precautions and monitoring.
scope: Decision and monitoring only; physical turning sequence not depicted.

title: Fracture • support and protect
caption: Severe injuries, open fractures or loss of circulation need urgent care.
alt: An arm rests on a support; prohibition and shield icons reinforce safe movement.
scope: Simple padded support concept, not prescribed splinting technique.

title: Epinephrine • device recognition
caption: Device designs and hold times vary; follow the label and dispatcher.
alt: Generic injector, hand and phone pictograms accompany prescribed medication and emergency response reminders.
scope: Generic auto-injector recognition, no actual needle, hand position or timing shown.

title: Possible spinal injury • precautions
caption: Follow dispatcher instructions if breathing is abnormal.
alt: Phone, head and shield pictograms illustrate movement precautions.
scope: General movement precautions, not a manual stabilization demonstration.

title: Heatstroke • cool immediately
caption: Keep the airway protected; do not force drinks on a confused person.
alt: Phone, water droplet and fan depict immediate help and cooling options.
scope: Cooling methods overview; no immersion posture or supervision technique demonstrated.

title: Hypothermia • protect from cold
caption: Seek emergency help for suspected severe hypothermia.
alt: Shield, folded blanket and thermometer depict shelter, insulation and warming.
scope: Protective equipment and warming reminders; no positioning or heat-device application technique.

title: Seizure • protect and time
caption: Call 911 for a first seizure, breathing trouble or other emergency signs.
alt: Cushion, clock and prohibition icons for seizure first aid.
scope: Protective equipment and timing reminders; no physical repositioning demonstration.

title: Thermal burn • cooling
caption: Seek urgent help for severe, large, deep or high-risk burns.
alt: Water drop, prohibition and shield icons illustrate burn cooling and protection.
scope: Cooling and dressing concepts only; no wound anatomy, timing or application sequence shown.
